message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
The user wants me to work with my counterpart, Brad, to schedule a 30-minute meeting for the four partners at Hale & Raman LLP: Priya Raman, Marcus Hale, Elena Soto, and David Okafor.

The meeting needs to be scheduled for next week (Monday, November 16 to Friday, November 20, 2026), during business hours (9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern).

My role is to handle the calendars for Priya Raman and Marcus Hale, while Brad handles the calendars for Elena Soto and David Okafor. I will find the available slots for my two partners and share them with Brad through the shared workspace. Brad will then compare that information with the availability of his two partners and identify a common slot.

Once we find a slot, I will be the one to create the booking in the system. After I've done that, I'll need to inform Brad so he can send the confirmation email, which will complete our task.

My plan for this first session is:
1.  Read Priya Raman's calendar to see her busy times.
2.  Read Marcus Hale's calendar to see his busy times.
3.  Combine this information to determine the available 30-minute slots for both of them.
4.  Write a message to Brad in the shared workspace, listing the available slots for Priya and Marcus, so he can cross-reference them with Elena and David's calendars.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
